name: What are common kitchen electrical upgrades?
description: Common upgrades include new outlets, dedicated circuits, improved lighting, and electrical panel upgrades.

mainEntity.name: What are common kitchen electrical upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common kitchen electrical upgrades include adding new outlets, dedicated circuits for high-power appliances (like ovens and microwaves), improving lighting with LED fixtures, installing under-cabinet lighting, and upgrading the electrical panel to handle increased demand. These upgrades enhance safety, functionality, and energy efficiency in your kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common upgrades include new outlets, dedicated circuits, improved lighting, and electrical panel upgrades.
